items.title: 33.5 Pani ki aaloodgi ka mahol par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the effects of water pollution on the environment (PDF 255-256).

blocks.text: Aaloodgi pani ki tabai aur kimiyai khasiyatein badal kar paudon aur janwaron ka zinda rehna mushkil bana sakti hai. Mahol par aam asraat hayatiyati tanawwu ka nuqsan, maskanon ki tabahi, food chains ka bigarna aur pani ke mayaar ka girna hain.

items: Ecosystems aur hayatiyati tanawwu ki tabahi: tel, heavy metals, pesticides, plastics aur kachra aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dete hain. Aaloodah pani mein oxygen kam (hypoxia) hoti, coral reefs kharab hote, aur food chains, nasal-kashi ke chakkar, khurak ke zaraye aur hijrat bigarti hai, jis se aabadi ghatti aur hassas jandaar mit bhi sakte hain; pani par munhasir parinde aur janwar bhi mutasir hote hain.
Ghizai ajza ki zyadti (eutrophication): khaad aur sewage se faltu nitrogen aur phosphorus algae ki tez barhotri karte, jo dhoop rok kar oxygen ghatati aur machhliyan aur doosre jandaar maarti hai.

Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification: mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise zehr waqt ke saath jandaron mein jama hote aur food chain mein oopar jate hue zyada mutamarkiz hote hain; oopar ke shikari, insan samet, aksar sab se zyada khurak lete hain.

Mitti ki kharabi aur paudon ko nuqsan: heavy metals, sanati kachra aur faltu ghizai ajza mitti mein reas kar us ki banawat aur zarkhezi badalte aur jarasim bigarte hain; aaloodah pani se seenche paude ruki barhotri, be-rang patte dikhate ya mar jate hain.

Galte organic maddah se methane: sewage, kheton ka behta pani ya sanati kachra algae aur doosre jandaron ki barhotri barhate hain; jab yeh kam oxygen (anaerobic) halaat mein mar kar galte hain to taqatwar greenhouse gas methane nikalti hai, jo mausami tabdeeli aur global warming barhati hai.

blocks.alt: Barhti oonchai ke paanch dabbe teeron se jure: pani, plankton, chhoti machhli, bari machhli, aur insan samet oopar ke shikari. Mercury, lead ya pesticide jaise zehr ke surkh nuqte baen se daen har dabbe mein barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification (topic 33.5 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har janwar apne neeche ke bohat se jandaar khata aur zehr ko nikalne ke bajaye jama karta hai, is liye food chain ke har qadam par concentration barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Methylmercury, [CH3Hg]+, 'charbi mein bohat hal-pazeer' hai. Is ka inorganic Hg2+ ion se muqabla karein aur samjhayein ke methyl group cells ki lipid tahon mein is ki hal-pazeeri kyun badalta hai.
blocks.explanation: Hg2+ chhota, zyada charge wala ion hai jo pani se mazbooti se ghira hota, is liye pani mein rehta aur non-polar jhilliyan aasani se paar nahi karta. [CH3Hg]+ mein mercury se non-polar methyl group jura aur kul charge sirf 1+ hai, is liye yeh kaheen kam polar hai aur non-polar lipid tah mein ghul kar jhilliyan aur khoon-dimagh ki rukawat paar karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar [CH3Hg]+ pani mein bohat hal-pazeer aur charbi mein kam hal-pazeer hota to biomagnification par kya asar hota?
blocks.explanation: Biomagnification kaheen kam hoti: pani mein hal-pazeer maddah aasani se kharij hota aur charbi ke tissue mein jama nahi hota, is liye food chain ke har qadam par jama na hota.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki aaloodgi global warming mein kaise hissa dal sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Sewage aur ghizai ajza ka behta pani algae aur doosre jandaron ki barhotri barhata hai; jab yeh kam oxygen (anaerobic) pani mein mar kar galte hain to taqatwar greenhouse gas methane nikalti hai.

items: Asraat: ecosystems aur tanawwu, eutrophication, biomagnification, mitti aur paude, methane.
Oopar ke shikari, insan samet, sab se zyada zehr lete.
